μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μυθέομαι: μυθέομαι — speak, say, declare; pres. 1 sg. mid. dep.: ’I speak’
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μώνυχες: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed (with an undivided hoof); adj., masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’) · also μή ποτε + fut. inf., the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μή ποτ’ … ἀλεξήσειν ’that never will I ward off’) · μηδέ (written μὴ δ’) — and not, not even; continuing a negative (μὴ δ’ ὁπότ’ ἂν ’not even when’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)

οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’) · also adv. of degree, with no genitive: ’exceedingly’ (πέρι … ἔρυτο ’guarded exceedingly’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its noun: ’around’ (πόλιν πέρι ’around the city’)
πέτετο: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’was flying, flew’
πέτρης: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. gen. sg.
παρθένος: παρθένος — maiden, unmarried girl; fem. nom. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πελώριον: πελώριος — huge, monstrous; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα: ’huge’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’huge’
πεποιθώς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting in’
πεπρωμένον: πόρω — grant, allot; perf. pass. part., neut. nom. sg.: ’fated, destined’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a person: ’allotted, fated’ (πεπρωμένον αἴσῃ ’fated by a lot’)

πετεηνῶν: πετεηνός — winged; pl. as noun, birds; masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πετεινῶν), with ὀρνίθων
πηλεΐδης: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
πηλεΐδῃ: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus (Achilles); masc. dat. sg.
πηλιάδα: Πηλιάς — of Pelion, Pelian; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μελίην
πιθήσας: πιθέω (epic aor. ἐπίθησα; cf. πείθομαι) — trust, obey (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’obeying’
πιθόμην: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι, obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. 2 mid. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπιθόμην)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολυπτύχου: πολύπτυχος — many-folded, with many ridges and glens; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus · also epithet of Mount Ida: ’many-folded’ (Ἴδης … πολυπτύχου)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
ποσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.

πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσαυδήτην: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 dual, epic -ήτην and unaugmented (= Attic προσηυδάτην)
πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
πρόφρονι: πρόφρων — eager, ready-minded, willing; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with θυμῷ: ’ready’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form) · also conj. + opt., after a negative in past time: ’before, until’ (πρὶν πειρήσαιτ’ ’until he made trial’) · also conj. + inf.: ’before’ (πρὶν … εἰσαφικέσθαι ’before reaching’)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’) · also adv. in διὰ πρό, ’right through’ (διὰ πρὸ … ἐλάσσαι ’drive right through’)

πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; fem. acc. sg.
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδεσσι: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ποσί)
πόληος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic -ηος (= Attic -εως), after ἐπιβαινέμεν · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἕρμα: ’of the city’ (ἕρμα πόληος ’prop of the city’)
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πύργῳ: πύργος — tower, bastion; masc. dat. sg.
σαώσομεν: σαόω — save, rescue (epic σαόω = Attic σῴζω); aor. subj. 1 pl. with short vowel, hortative after ἄγετε: ’let us save’ (the form is also fut. indic.: ’we shall save’)
σείων: σείω — shake, brandish; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’shaking’
σιγαλόεντα: σιγαλόεις — glossy, gleaming (sense uncertain); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἡνία
σκαμάνδρου: Σκάμανδρος — Scamander, the river of Troy and its god; masc. gen. sg., with ἀρητήρ: ’priest of Scamander’
σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated · also accented before the enclitic μοι (ὅ τέ μοι), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated · also accented before the enclitic με (ὅς τέ με), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’child’ (ἴδωμι φίλον τέκος)
τήνδ: ὅδε — this (one); fem. acc. sg., elided (τήνδ’ = τήνδε): ’this’

ταχέεσσι: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic ταχέσι)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείχεα: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τείχη)
τείχεος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’)

τρέσε: τρέω — flee in fear, take fright; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτρεσε)
τριτογένεια: Τριτογένεια — Tritogeneia, title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed (linked to a lake/river Triton, to a word for ’head’, or to ’third-born’)
τροίηνδ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. with the suffix -δε ’to’, elided (Τροίηνδ’ = Τροίηνδε): ’to Troy’
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῳάδας: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. acc. pl., object of αἰδέομαι: ’Trojan women’ · also fem. acc. pl., object of ἐϋφρανέω: ’Trojan women’
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’)
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
φάρμακ: φάρμακον — drug, potion, medicine; neut. acc. pl., elided (φάρμακ’ = φάρμακα)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
φεύγων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’fleeing’
φοβεῖται: φοβέομαι — be frightened, flee in fear; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., with a neut. pl. subject: ’are terrified’ · also pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., with a neut. sg. subject (κῆρ): ’takes flight’ · also pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., with a fem. sg. subject: ’is afraid’
φράζεσθε: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, take heed; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’consider’
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
ψυχῆς: ψυχή — life, breath of life, soul; fem. gen. sg.
ἀΐξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
ἀέθλια: ἀέθλιον — prize, contest-prize (epic; cf. Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. pl.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; fem. acc. sg.
ἀκροτάτῃ: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superlative ἀκρότατος, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with κορυφῇ · also fem. dat. sg., with a noun understood: ’on the topmost (part)’ (ἐπ’ ἀκροτάτῃ ’on the very top’)
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοιιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dual dat./gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ἀλλήλοιν)
ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός · also fem. nom. sg., predicate of φιλοφροσύνη: ’better’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc. gen. sg.
ἀνιόντος: ἄνειμι — go up, rise (of the sun); pres. part. masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute: ’as it rises’
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’) · also masc. nom. sg. used adverbially: ’head-on, face to face’
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀργικέραυνε: ἀργικέραυνος — of the flashing thunderbolt; masc. voc. sg., epithet of Zeus
ἀρχή: ἀρχή — beginning, origin, first cause; fem. nom. sg., as a predicate noun: ’the beginning’
ἀσπίδ: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. acc. sg., elided ἀσπίδ’
ἀτασθαλίῃσιν: ἀτασθαλίη — wanton folly, reckless wrongdoing; fem. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -αις)
ἀτρεΐδῃσιν: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (Agamemnon, Menelaus); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοῖς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄγειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. inf. act.
ἄγετε: ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 pl., in the interjection ἄγε/ἄγετε: ’come now!’
ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλα): ’others’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄνδιχα: ἄνδιχα — in two, apart; adv. (= ἀνὰ δίχα, Attic δίχα)
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἐέργει: εἴργω — shut in, enclose; pres. 3 sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (ἐγών = ἐγώ)
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλω: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 1 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐκέλευε: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept bidding’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμμεμαὼς: ἐμμέμαα (μέμονα, with ἐν-) — press on eagerly; perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, rushing on’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμῇσιν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic ἐμαῖς)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
ἐνυαλίῳ: Ἐνυάλιος — Enyalius, a name of Ares; masc. dat. sg.
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνώμα: νωμάω — handle, wield, ply; impf. 3 sg.: ’was handling’ · also impf. 3 sg. with the limbs as object: ’set moving, plied’ (γούνατ’ ἐνώμα ’set his knees moving’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’ · ἐκ — in ἐξ ἄλλων (ἐκ + gen.), ’from among the others, more than the rest’
ἐξαναλῦσαι: ἐξαναλύω — loose back out of; aor. inf. act. (ἐξ + ἀνά + λύω), + gen.: ’to loose again out of’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπήρατον: ἐπήρατος — lovely, desirable; adj. of two endings, neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐπαινέομεν: ἐπαινέω — approve, agree to; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπαινοῦμεν)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρινεὸν: ἐρινεός — wild fig-tree; masc. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the wild fig tree’ · also masc. acc. sg., the tree cut from, object of τάμνε beside a second acc.: ’the wild fig-tree’ (ἐρινεὸν … τάμνε νέους ὄρπηκας ’cut young shoots from the fig-tree’)
ἐρώει: ἐρωέω — hold back, hang back; pres. imper. 2 sg., after μηδ’: ’do not hang back’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐσσεύοντο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic augment with doubled σ (ἐσσ-): ’rushed’
ἐϊκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐϊκυῖα (= Attic ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑλέειν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. inf., epic -έειν (= Attic ἑλεῖν)
ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
ἑλκεσιπέπλους: ἑλκεσίπεπλος — with trailing robes; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with Τρῳάδας
ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔλθω: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. (ἦλθον) subj. 1 sg., short-vowel, in a condition after εἰ … κε: ’if I go’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπειθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl. (the ending also serves 1 sg.): ’they tried to persuade’
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + gen. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νήσων ἔπι ’to the islands’)
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔρδ: ἔρδω — do, perform (epic by-form of ῥέζω); pres. imper. 2 sg. act., elided (ἔρδ’ = ἔρδε): ’do it’
ἔριδι: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. dat. sg.
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., with movable ν: ’is’ · also with an infinitive, ’it is possible to’ (ἔστιν ἐρίζειν ’it is possible to rival’)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’ · also ’holding, possessing’, of a lord and his land (Πήδασον ἔχων ’holding Pedasus’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with πειράω, the opponent: ’(make trial) with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person deprived: ’(taken) from Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’) · also in tmesis (διὰ … ἕλε = διεῖλε): ’tore through’ (διὰ δ’ ἀμφοτέρους ἕλε κύκλους ’tore through both rings’)
ἕλωμαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I shall take’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., after μή of fear: ’lest I take’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., in a condition with αἴ κε: ’if I take’
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question · also ἠέ, ’or’, introducing a further alternative in a list (ἠέ ποθι ’or somewhere’) · also ἠέ, ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠέ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’) · also ἠέ, ’than’, after a verb of wishing, with no comparative: ’rather than’ (δοῦναι κράτος ἠέ περ ἡμῖν ’to give strength rather than to us’) · also ἠέ … ἠέ, correlative ’either … or’, in a statement · also ἠέ … ἦέ, ’either … or’ (’whether … or’), in a direct double question (ἠέ τι βέβληαι … ἦέ τευ ἀγγελίης ’have you been hit … or have you come with news’) · also ἠέ … ἤ, correlative ’either … or’ in a statement (ἠέ τινα … ἢ αὐτός ’either someone … or he himself’)
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠγάγετο: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. take with oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’brought with him’ · mid. take home as a wife; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented
ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω) · also ἤ = ἦ with μοι in a self-addressed question: ’why indeed …?’ (τί ἤ μοι)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’)
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε), second member of an alternative question
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
ἵκωμαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I come to’
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. inf. mid.: ’to perish’
ὀλοφύρεται: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, grieve, feel pity; pres. 3 sg.: ’grieves’
ὀλοὴν: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. acc. sg.
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀρέξῃ: ὀρέγω — reach out, hold out, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in an indefinite relative clause: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a condition, with ἄν or κε: ’should grant’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁπποτέρῳ: ὁππότερος — whichever of the two; masc. dat. sg., indefinite relative (= Attic ὁπότερος)
ὁρῶμαι: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg. mid. with active sense (epic): ’I behold’
ὁρῶντο: ὁράω — see, look at; impf. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἑωρῶντο)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄρεσφιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. pl. in -φιν serving as gen. or dat. (= Attic ὀρῶν, ὄρεσι): ’from, in the mountains’
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅπῃ: ὅπῃ — where, whither, in whatever way; relative adv., also in an indirect question: ’how, in what way’
ὅρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — turn over in the mind, ponder; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὥρμαινε): ’pondered’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
ὅσην: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; fem. acc. sg., of amount: ’as much as’
ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of its verb: ’whatever’ (ὅσσά κεν αὐτοὶ δῶσιν ’whatever they themselves may give’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with its noun: ’as many (prizes) as’ (ὅσσά … ἀέθλια)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’)
ὑπεχώρει: ὑποχωρέω — give way, retire; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’gave way’
ὕδατι: ὕδωρ — water; neut. dat. sg., of means
ὕπαιθα: ὕπαιθα — from beneath, aside; adv., of swerving: ’aside’ · also with a gen., ’at the side of, from beneath’ (ὕπαιθα ἄνακτος ’at their lord’s side’)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’) · also adv. in tmesis after its verb, with an acc.: ’escaping’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ = ὑποφυγών, ’escaping the pitiless day’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὤλεσα: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg.: ’I lost’
ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed, lost’
ὤρετο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented, + inf.: ’bestirred himself, set himself (to)’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ῥέει: ῥέω — flow; pres. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥεῖ)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
